title: Set Field By Name (dynamic target)
description: Code-style rule — Set Field By Name steps. The target field is computed at runtime, so static analysis and refactoring cannot follow it.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A dynamic field target is invisible to where-used and rename tooling.
rule.remediation: Prefer a static Set Field where the target is known at design time.
